title: Prompt Engineering Basics
subtitle: System prompts, user messages, and clear instructions

content.text: Prompt engineering is the practice of crafting inputs that reliably get the output you need. Clear, specific prompts outperform vague ones.

content.definition: Instructions at the top of the conversation that set the model's persona and rules.

content.text: Provide output format examples in the prompt. Models imitate format much more reliably than following abstract format descriptions.

questions.question: What is the system prompt used for?
options: Providing persistent instructions and persona to the model
questions.explanation: The system prompt sets the model's role, rules, and output format before the conversation begins.

faq.q: Should I explain the reasoning behind my instructions?
faq.a: Yes. LLMs follow instructions better when they understand the goal. "Reply in JSON for easy parsing" is clearer than just "Reply in JSON."

examples: Building a structured data extractor from unstructured text
